own_words.text: "Restructuring City Hall to 2015 staffing levels would save $220M, completely closing the City's operational deficit."
"Balboa Park parking fees must be repealed entirely." He also wants downtown parking rates rolled back to early-2025 levels.

candidates.name: Nicole Crosby

Wants to "strengthen San Diego's sanctuary city policies" and keep city police resources out of ICE operations that violate residents' rights.

Raised in Valencia Park; Lincoln High and Hampton University graduate.

After the January 2024 floods, redirected Community Equity Fund money to affected families and sought federal money for the Jamacha drainage channel.
On the budget: "we need to get over the fear of having uncomfortable conversations."

candidates.background: Neonatal ICU nurse and community organizer; describes herself as an immigrant and single mother. Trailed Foster by 12 votes in the June primary. Ballot designation: Neonatal ICU Nurse/Mother.

own_words.text: "As a Nurse, I took an oath to do no harm. I intend to continue that oath at City Hall."
Would hold "a town hall within the first 30 days" to set priorities with residents.
Wants policies that "preserve affordable housing, tenant protections" and protect communities from displacement.
